info.title: Scrolls read API
info.description: Loopback-only, read-only knowledge API. Numeric loopback bind only; remote access requires a tunnel. Host must be localhost, canonical loopback or the bound IP at the actual listening port. Requests carrying Origin are refused; no CORS. Every success except /healthz requires a current locked backend read; no stale success. Local format 4 and existing shared format 5/writer 3 only. No migration, recovery, audit appends, Beads I/O, mutation, file export or arbitrary SQL. Query bodies are limited to 65536 bytes. Unknown query parameters and duplicate scalar parameters are rejected. Error codes and messages are stable and sanitized.

get.description: Complete records keyed by ID and relationships keyed by their existing graph keys, including external endpoints. No pagination or filters. Record original payloads, import metadata and source-file bytes are excluded. The existing read session is released before transmission.

Record.description: Existing Scrolls record envelope; fields follow the active ontology. All record revisions are numeric.

Reference.description: Immediate/traversal reference, including direction and relation when applicable; external references may have null metadata.

provenance.description: Source, profile, commit, path and membership metadata when requested; null for native documents or when omitted.

next_cursor.description: Opaque request/snapshot/last-item binding. Repeat the same filters and limit. Restart on snapshot_changed.

revision.description: Added by the HTTP proposal collection; proposal commit revision.

review_token.description: Same revision-bound inspection token as CLI. No HTTP acceptance endpoint exists.

expression.description: Existing Scrolls declarative expression: all, any, not, compare, exists, relation, path_glob, applicability or date_plus. No SQL or filenames.

actor.description: Overrides the server actor binding for this query; cooperative attribution, not authentication.

at.description: Evaluation time; defaults to current UTC.

Error400.description: Malformed request, invalid predicate/filter/budget, rejected Host or Origin.

Error404.description: Unknown record, alias, proposal or route.

Error409.description: snapshot_changed or store_state_conflict; restart pagination or perform explicit maintenance.

Error503.description: backend_unavailable or busy. Admission and local-lock waits each bounded to five seconds; shared waits use connection budgets.
